ST-02.notes: Implemented: added Content-Security-Policy meta tag to public/index.html. Issue #119 closed by governance_sync.yml. Deviation: no prior canonical spec for CSP — feature absent from spec. Noted in qa_evidence_EPIC-01.md (absence note only, per LL-v1.10-P4-2). DoQ to confirm: browser console clean under CSP.
